cases.title: Case studies
cases.subtitle: Three real systems, with the problem, the solution, the results and the role AI played in each.

patologia.name: Pathology V2 · RISMI (Madariaga Hospital)
patologia.problem: The pathology system is a PHP 5.6 application with no framework, holding hundreds of thousands of historical studies of several types (PAP, HPV, biopsies, colon).
patologia.solution: I am migrating it as one more application inside RISMI (Laravel and Vue.js): single sign-on, roles, auditing and navigation from the platform, with functional parity with the old system, reports included.
results: Domain with more than 350,000 historical studies across 8 study types
More than 150 automated tests (Vitest and Cypress) passing
Delivered in batches, with a technical report per batch
QA with the user area applied batch by batch
patologia.aiRole: AI agents survey the old system, implement in batches and generate tests. I set the scope, review every change and validate it with QA.

cgm.name: CGM · Document management (Misiones Government House)
cgm.problem: Digitize intake, numbering and tracking of case files, respecting the physical forms the agency already uses.
cgm.solution: Laravel microservices (authentication and permissions, intake, case files) with a Next.js 14 frontend and PostgreSQL. Images are built in GitHub Actions and published to GHCR; the server only pulls and starts them.
results: Sequential numbering with locking, no duplicates
A4 cover sheet that replicates the physical form
Import of 427 agency codes with preview and audit trail
cgm.aiRole: Every requirement is written in a document. Agents implement it, and I verify with automated tests, type checking and an automated browser before publishing.

clerk.name: Clerk AI · Multi-tenant conversational assistant
clerk.problem: Businesses need to handle repetitive questions with an assistant that knows their information, with its own panel and licensing.
clerk.solution: Laravel API with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): text chunking, embeddings in pgvector and a language model. Landing page and admin panel in Next.js, with plan, payment and license management.
results: More than 780 commits and more than 100 test files
Separate panels for tenants and super-admin
clerk.aiRole: It is the core of the product: it plugs a language model into a knowledge retrieval flow, and I design, test and operate each piece.

method.title: How I work with AI
method.subtitle: AI speeds things up. Judgment, verification and accountability are mine.

steps.title: Written requirement
steps.text: Every change starts from a document with scope and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Batch implementation
steps.text: Agents work on small batches, with repository rules kept in an AGENTS.md file.
